extractions.value: Patient had chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) diagnosed approximately 1 year before symptom onset. The published SUMMARY states a 61-year-old man while the CASE PRESENTATION states a 66-year-old man; discrepancy preserved. The routine laboratory result is described as 'mild pancytopenia' although the quoted leucocyte count (37.9×1000/ml) is raised. Autonomic instability (profuse sweating, mydriasis, tachycardia, high blood pressure, hyperthermia) followed by cardiac arrest occurred 2 days after the second course of rituximab/bendamustine.
extractions.quote: the patient was diagnosed with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) approximately 1 year before symptom onset ...
